parts.text: Good evening, and thank you for coming out on such a cold night.
Tonight I want to talk about a very old question, which is whether the world
is there when nobody is looking at it.
The realist says that it is. The world, for the realist, is mind independent, meaning
it's not pegged on or subject to
what any of us happens to believe about it.
Now that sounds obvious, and most people in this room probably agree with it before I have said anything else at all,
but the arguments against it are older than you might think.
Take the colour of an apple.
We say the apple is red, but red is something that happens
between the light, the skin of the apple and the eye, and without an eye there is only light of a certain length.
So is the redness in the apple, or in us?
Here is where it gets interesting.
If you pull on that thread long enough, shape and size and number start to look
a little like colour too, and the realist has to say where the line is.
Some draw it at what physics measures, others at what any careful observer would agree on,
and a few, the brave ones, refuse to draw it at all.
I am going to defend a modest version of the first view, and then
spend the second half of the evening on the best objection to it,
which comes, surprisingly, from inside physics itself.
Before we start, a word about questions.
Please keep them until the end, unless you are lost, in which case
raise your hand and I will go back.
Okay, let's get started, we have three things on the list today.
First the home screen, then the login page, and then the monthly reports, which
I know some of you have been waiting for.
On the home screen, the client asked for the dashboard to come up
first, right after you log in, instead of the inbox.
They also want a filter by date and a button that exports everything to Excel, and honestly I think that is fair,
it should not take long.
Login is harder.
It has to support a one time code on the phone before the end of
the month, and the security team wants to review it first.
Sam, could you take that one? You did the last change to the sign in flow, so
you know where everything is.
Sure, but I will need the new API from the backend team
by Sunday at the latest.
Fine. The reports are the last thing. The numbers in the monthly report do not match
the invoices, and nobody is sure yet whether the report or the invoices are wrong.
We will go through them with accounting on Monday, and
come back to you with the details on Tuesday.
Great. Thanks, everyone, see you next week.
طيب، خلونا نبدأ. اليوم عندنا ثلاث نقاط على الجدول.
أول شي الشاشة الرئيسية، وبعدها صفحة الدخول، وبعدين التقارير الشهرية اللي
كثير منكم كان ينتظرها.
بالنسبة للشاشة الرئيسية، العميل طلب إن الـ dashboard يطلع
أول شي بعد الدخول مباشرة، بدل صندوق الرسائل.
وكمان بدهم فلتر حسب التاريخ، وزر export للـ Excel، وبصراحة هذا طلب معقول وما راح ياخذ وقت طويل،
إن شاء الله.
تسجيل الدخول أصعب شوي.
لازم يدعم الـ OTP على الجوال قبل نهاية
الشهر، وفريق الأمن بده يراجعه قبل ما نطلقه.
سامي، تقدر تاخذ هالمهمة؟ أنت اللي عملت آخر تعديل على صفحة الدخول، يعني
بتعرف وين كل شي.
أكيد، بس بحتاج الـ API الجديد من فريق الـ backend
يوم الأحد على الأكثر.
تمام. آخر نقطة التقارير. الأرقام في التقرير الشهري ما بتطابق
الـ invoices، ولسا ما حدا متأكد إذا الغلط في التقرير ولا في الفواتير.
رح نراجعها مع المحاسبة يوم الاثنين، و
نرجعلكم بالتفاصيل يوم الثلاثاء.
ممتاز، شكرًا للجميع، نلتقي الأسبوع الجاي.
